name: Registrar-gated editable adapter synchronization

atomicDiscipline.rule: Run exactly the printed hypothesis. If the attempted change fails, degrades, or suggests a different fix, revert to the checkpoint and finish this experiment as failure. Start a new experiment for the next idea.

primaryTarget: headed WASM/WebGPU TextArea fixture at DPR 1 and DPR 2
hypothesisMarkdown:
## Registrar-gated editable adapter synchronization

Only synchronize `EditableTextSelectableAdapter` while the current traversal scope exposes a SelectionArea registrar. Outside a SelectionArea, retain local ownership without reading text, layout, or rebuilding the row hit map.

Allowed production scope: `selection_area/mod.rs`, `selection_area/state.rs`, and `selection_area/editable_text_selectable_adapter.rs`.

Preserve local editing, IME, scrolling, privacy, and every SelectionArea gesture. Do not change hit-map geometry, participant reconciliation, or selection rendering in this experiment.
measurementPlanMarkdown:
### Measurement plan

Measure the existing 2,000-line TextArea fixture with headed WASM/WebGPU at DPR 1 and DPR 2 using 35 repetitions per project, discarding the five configured warmups. Compare p50 and p95 input-to-published-frame durations before and after the gate.

Run the focused TextArea and SelectionArea fixtures after the change. Inspect the DPR 2 TextArea screenshot and retain its JSON/image artifacts. The static gate is that adapter synchronization is unreachable when no registrar is present.
expectedOutcomeMarkdown:
### Expected outcome

The standalone TextArea fixture should avoid SelectionArea adapter text and row-hit-map work, improving or maintaining p50 and p95 while preserving rendered scroll behavior. The SelectionArea fixture must continue to register and operate normally.

Reject the experiment if a focused fixture fails, a screenshot regresses, or the standalone TextArea p95 worsens by more than five percent.

measurements.target: headed WASM/WebGPU, 35 repetitions per DPR with five warmups discarded

reportMarkdown:
## Registrar-gated editable adapter synchronization

`EditableTextSelectionElement::paint` now asks `SelectionContext` whether the current traversal has a registrar before reading the editable model or synchronizing the adapter. Outside a SelectionArea it resets to local ownership directly, so it cannot clone the editable text or rebuild row hit maps for a registrar that cannot consume it.

In 30 measured samples per DPR, input-to-published-frame p50/p95 improved from 126.2468/135.2297 ms to 63.41/89.48 ms at DPR 1 and from 133.9514/136.3979 ms to 86.43/93.75 ms at DPR 2. The aggregate Playwright elapsed time varied with browser/process startup and is recorded separately rather than used as the acceptance metric.

The focused TextArea fixture passed 70 headed WASM/WebGPU repetitions, the focused SelectionArea fixture passed at DPR 1 and DPR 2, and the fresh DPR 1 TextArea screenshot retained the expected 2,000-line scrolled rendering.
decisionMarkdown:
## Decision

Keep the registrar gate. It uses the existing scoped SelectionContext, adds no allocation or new lifecycle, and removes the otherwise unusable editable adapter synchronization outside SelectionArea traversal.
notes: Raw Playwright JSON and screenshot artifacts are retained under tools-node/.agentx/experiments/2026-07-24-gpux-text-quality-and-performance-wasm-baseline/15-adapter-registrar-gate-output/.
